title: Joined annotation pieces recover an exact retained citation cue

method: Use the original source cut and annotation task with both recipe versions. Compare the cue extent and native pointer, exercise producer, native negative controls and archived replay, and generate the development candidate in a rollback-only transaction.
commands: uv run ci test retry 1df13f4a90f34676afd9cc1c200c54bb --lane ordinary --json
uv run ci model change candidate b2dac999737744109adb4155e4e533c7 --json
uv run ci model change register d1eef86361c94c83810c48ad52d53f1d --json

conclusion: The new recipe finds the exact Section 5.1 citation on native item #/texts/21384 using the explicit piece map of retained annotation block #/texts/21382.
